fields.label: Sync Enabled
fields.description: Master switch, OFF by default. While off, nothing is queued and the scheduled workers return immediately — the sync feature is completely inert. Turn it on only once the remote settings below are filled in and tested.

fields.options:
This site pushes its completed sales to a remote URY site for head-office reporting. It is meant for a branch-local install whose internet is unreliable: sales are queued locally and sent whenever a connection is available, retrying indefinitely so nothing is lost.

Only ever enable this on a branch site, never on the cloud site it pushes to.

fields.label: Remote Site URL
fields.description: Base URL of the cloud site, e.g. https://landing.erpxpand.com — no trailing slash and no path.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: From a dedicated user on the REMOTE site. Give that user only what the receiver needs — do not reuse an administrator key.

fields.label: Connection Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Must stay well below the sweeper's stale-claim threshold (600s), or a row still legitimately in flight could be reclaimed and pushed twice.

fields.label: Rows Per Run
fields.description: How many queued sales one worker pass sends. Kept modest so a long backlog drains steadily instead of saturating a weak link.

fields.label: Alert Role
fields.description: Who hears about a sale that has failed to sync for ~48 minutes, or one rejected outright.
